mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine's sympathomimetic effects can cause potassium shifts and increase renal potassium excretion, while potassium supplementation may not adequately correct amphetamine-induced hypokalemia or could lead to hyperkalemia in certain renal or cardiac conditions.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly in patients receiving lisdexamfetamine with potassium supplementation; assess renal function and adjust potassium dosing accordingly to maintain normal potassium homeostasis.
